title: Machine Learning Models to Predict Primary Sites of Metastatic Cervical Carcinoma From Unknown Primary.
summary: Machine-learning models using molecular and clinical features predicted the primary site of metastatic cervical carcinoma of unknown origin, with classification performance reported against known-site cases.
